title: Chow groups of symmetric products of projective spaces
summary: Let $\operatorname{SP}^{d}(\mathbb{P}^{n})$ denote the $d$-th symmetric product of complex projective space. We prove that its integral cycle class map is split injective and has finite cokernel annihilated by $d!$. We also compute the ranks of its Chow groups. By constructing compatible integral retractions on Chow groups and singular homology, we prove that addition of a fixed point induces an isomorphism on the Chow group of $q$-dimensional cycles whenever $d\geq q$.
